title: Unlocking the Specialization Capability of PPG Foundation Models for Wearable Signals through Structured Pruning and Adaptive Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.33788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) plays a central role in wearable health monitoring and clinical decision support. However, existing approaches to universal PPG representation learning are predominantly trained on high-quality large-scale datasets obtained from oximeters in hospital settings and often struggle to adapt to sparse and low-quality real-world datasets, thereby limiting their generalization to clinically relevant tasks on prevalent PPG data such as collected from wearable devices. Surprisingly, even after full fine-tuning, PPG foundation models cannot consistently outperform general-purpose time-series models. Therefore, a key question is how to effectively adapt PPG foundation models to target prediction tasks. translated_title: 通过结构化剪枝与自适应微调释放PPG基础模型对可穿戴信号的专业化能力
translated_abstract: 光电容积描记术（PPG）在可穿戴健康监测和临床决策支持中发挥着核心作用。然而，现有的通用PPG表征学习方法主要是在医院环境中通过血氧仪获得的高质量大规模数据集上训练的，往往难以适应稀疏且低质量的真实世界数据集，从而限制了它们在普遍存在的PPG数据（例如从可穿戴设备采集的数据）上对临床相关任务的泛化能力。令人惊讶的是，即使经过全量微调，PPG基础模型也无法持续超越通用时间序列模型。因此，一个关键问题是如何有效地将PPG基础模型适配到目标预测任务上。通过对多种PPG基础模型的实证研究，我们发现预训练模型通常表现出固有的稀疏性和计算冗余，这表明PPG基础模型已经学会激活与任务相关（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现PPG基础模型存在固有稀疏性和计算冗余，提出通过结构化剪枝与自适应微调来有效释放其面向可穿戴PPG信号预测任务的专业化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the inherent sparsity and computational redundancy in PPG foundation models and proposes structured pruning combined with adaptive fine-tuning to effectively unlock their specialization capability for wearable PPG signal prediction tasks.
